selection: Deliberate priority task after user-authorized program expansion, not a random task draw
actor: same primary agent; author-performed trial, not independent newcomer
question: Does removing the original30-gene restriction improve prediction on development folds and the already exposed Broad77?
development: exact773 historical development identities only; target-specific finite outcomes; no historicalfinal or Sanger
candidate: ridge with top300 absolute training Pearson-correlated expression genes, selected afresh inside every inner-training and outer-training fold
reference: ridge on original30 expression genes, with identical folds/preprocessing/alpha selection; lineage baseline; frozen originalstrong comparator retained for external context
feature_universe: stable EntrezID intersection of old expression and manuscript nextgen expression headers; no selection by new expression values or outcomes
gene_eligibility: at least90percent observed in current training fold and nonconstant after training-median imputation; reference requires all30 eligible; wide requires at least300
preprocessing: training-fold median imputation, population standard deviation scaling; no release correction or new cohort recalibration
selection_metric: minimum pooled inner-OOF MSE, exact ties choose larger alpha
primary: macro target-wise Spearman difference wide minus panel30 on complete development OOF predictions, all12 targets
secondary: all77 Broad transfer wide vs panel30, lineage and frozen originalstrong; pertarget rho/MSE, coverage, selectedfeature counts; no pass-dependent evaluation selection
bootstrap: 2000 shared identity draws seed20261021 for Broad wide-minus-panel30 and wide-minus-originalstrong; conditional, exploratory, no claim of fresh confirmation
coverage: all frozen77organoid rows; selectedfeature missingness imputed from development and reported; no outcome-based target/row exclusion; unexpected nonfinite data or incomplete target coverage fails
freeze: model bundles, source/protocol bindings, all predictions locked before opening Broad responses this round; Broad has already been exposed historically
success: a reproducible broader-feature reference and a falsifiable breadth comparison; negative result counts as investigation, not a performance gain
not_claimed: exact reproduction of a published method
reserved: Sanger outcomes not opened; newtargets/modalities require a separate declared task rather than post-score expansion
